title: Sabah gelir

characters.WOMAN: a young woman with long wavy red hair, wearing light grey pajamas and a cozy blue cardigan

scenes.text: Bazı geceler hiç bitmeyecekmiş gibi gelir.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet bedroom at night, {WOMAN} sits on the edge of her bed hugging a pillow, looking at the dark blue window, a small lamp glowing.
{WOMAN} lies awake in bed with open eyes looking up at the ceiling, soft moonlight across the blanket, a cat sleeping at her feet.

scenes.text:
Ama dışarıda bir kuş,
sabahı çoktan bekliyor.
scenes.prompt: Outside a window on a tree branch, a small robin sits awake under the fading stars, the sky slowly turning deep blue to lavender.

scenes.text: Ve gökyüzü kimseye sormadan yavaşça pembeleşir.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} stands at the open window wrapped in her cardigan, watching a soft pink dawn over the rooftops, the robin on the branch nearby.
{WOMAN} smiles with closed eyes as warm morning sunlight fills her room, holding a cup of tea at the window, birds flying in the pink sky.

caption:
Ne kadar uzun sürerse sürsün, her gece sabaha varır. 🤍

Bu aralar zor geceler geçiren birine gönder.
